finding.summary: npm() collapsed every npm failure mode (non-zero exit, spawn error, the 30000 ms timeout) into null; a null `npm root -g` result became a null pkgFile, which was treated exactly like a missing package and printed 'OMNIROUTE_INSTALL_COMPAT: SKIP NOT_INSTALLED' with exit 0, silently dropping all six checks, and tests/pkg-t3-omniroute-install-compat.test.ts accepted that line, so the canonical tests step could PASS with zero verification.

remediationRounds.fix: The npm runner now returns the raw spawnSync result (an unresolvable npm invocation, e.g. a missing npm-cli.js, is carried as an error result instead of an uncaught throw). The new exported classifyNpmRoot accepts the `npm root -g` result only when there is no spawn error, the exit status is 0 and stdout is exactly one non-empty line that is an absolute path to an existing directory; a spawn error (SPAWN_ERROR_<code>), timeout (TIMEOUT), signal (SIGNAL_<sig>), missing status (NO_EXIT_STATUS), non-zero exit (EXIT_<n>), empty/whitespace output (EMPTY_OUTPUT), multiple lines (MULTIPLE_LINES), a relative or garbage path (NOT_ABSOLUTE), a missing path (NOT_FOUND) or a non-directory (NOT_DIRECTORY) is unavailable. main then prints {status: FAIL, reason: NPM_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE, detail, npmRoot: null} and 'OMNIROUTE_INSTALL_COMPAT: FAIL NPM_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE reason=<detail>' and exits 1. 'SKIP NOT_INSTALLED' with exit 0 is reached only after a validated global root that has no omniroute/package.json; the PASS 6/6 path and the npm prefix -g path are unchanged. No environment override or other test hook was added to the production script; the tests inject a fake npm through the real invocation path (on win32 a copy of node.exe whose sibling node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js is the fake, exactly where resolveNpmInvocation looks; elsewhere a fake npm first on PATH).
regressionTests: tests/pkg-t3-omniroute-install-compat.test.ts 'F-T3-003: npm global root measurement failure is a FAIL, never an honest skip' > 'reports FAIL NPM_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE and exits non-zero for every unusable npm root -g result' (9 cases: exit 1 with a usable-looking root, exit 1 without output, empty, whitespace-only, garbage, relative, multiple lines, absolute missing path, absolute file path)

tests/pkg-t3-omniroute-install-compat.test.ts 'F-T3-003: ...' > 'reports FAIL NPM_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE when npm cannot be resolved or spawned' (win32: npm-cli.js missing beside node.exe -> SPAWN_ERROR_NPM_CLI_NOT_FOUND; other platforms: npm not on PATH -> SPAWN_ERROR_ENOENT)

tests/pkg-t3-omniroute-install-compat.test.ts 'F-T3-003: ...' > 'still skips honestly when npm works and the resolved global root has no OmniRoute' (a real empty temp directory as the root -> exit 0, SKIP NOT_INSTALLED, npmRoot equals that directory)

tests/pkg-t3-omniroute-install-compat.test.ts 'F-T3-003: ...' > 'classifies spawn errors, timeouts and signals as unavailable and only a clean single absolute directory as usable' (ETIMEDOUT, ENOENT, resolver throw, error with status 0, SIGKILL, null status, valid CRLF-terminated directory)

tests/pkg-t3-omniroute-install-compat.test.ts 'passes or honestly skips when OmniRoute is not installed': existing assertions kept verbatim; added that a SKIP must carry an absolute existing npmRoot without omniroute/package.json and that a PASS must carry six PASS checks
